entries.name: LangChain / LangGraph
entries.what: Open-source frameworks for building agents, with the LangSmith platform for tracing and evaluation.
entries.note: LangGraph gives low-level control over agent workflows.

entries.name: CrewAI
entries.what: Multi-agent platform for building, running and governing enterprise agents.

entries.name: Microsoft Agent Framework (AutoGen)
entries.what: Framework for building agentic solutions; its docs include migration guides from AutoGen and Semantic Kernel.
entries.note: Appears to succeed AutoGen and Semantic Kernel; the page does not say so explicitly.

entries.name: Semantic Kernel
entries.what: SDK for building AI agents.
entries.note: The repository calls Microsoft Agent Framework its enterprise-ready successor.

entries.name: LlamaIndex
entries.what: Document parsing and extraction tools (LlamaParse) for agents.
entries.note: The company now centers on document processing.

entries.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
entries.what: Python toolkit for agents that use tools, hand off work to other agents and run guardrail checks.

entries.name: Claude Agent SDK
entries.what: SDK for building agents on the same agent loop that powers Claude Code.

entries.name: Agent Development Kit (ADK)
entries.what: Google's open-source kit for building and deploying agents.

entries.name: smolagents
entries.what: Barebones library for agents that think in code.

entries.name: Haystack
entries.what: Open-source framework for LLM-driven agents and applications.

entries.name: Pydantic AI
entries.what: Python framework for building agents with typed outputs.

entries.name: Mastra
entries.what: Open-source TypeScript framework for AI agents and applications.

entries.name: Letta
entries.what: Research lab and platform for agents that keep memory and learn from experience.

entries.name: MetaGPT
entries.what: Multi-agent framework that assigns roles to models so they work like a software team.
entries.note: MIT license; the repository is large and maintained.

entries.name: SWE-agent
entries.what: Research tool that attempts to fix GitHub issues with a model of your choice.

entries.name: AgentGPT
entries.what: Browser-based platform to assemble and deploy autonomous agents.
entries.note: The page shows a Beta label; we could not confirm recent activity.

entries.name: Roo Code
entries.what: Coding agent; roocode.com now redirects to roomote.dev.

entries.name: Carly
entries.what: AI executive assistant.
entries.note: The site blocks automated reading; not yet verified.

entries.name: MiniMax Agent
entries.what: Agent product from MiniMax; the page names it MiniMax Code.
entries.note: Product name and scope unclear on the page.

entries.name: Sweep
entries.what: Coding assistant for JetBrains IDEs with an agent and autocomplete.
entries.note: Free to try; little public detail on pricing or scope, so it is listed without a score.
